title: ATS job listings
description: Company board slugs per ATS. Each board is read from its public job-board API. Unknown slugs return a not_found row and the run continues. No proxy, CAPTCHA solver, or browser is used.

greenhouse.title: Greenhouse boards
greenhouse.description: Greenhouse board tokens, such as airbnb from boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb. A board URL is accepted too.

lever.title: Lever sites
lever.description: Lever site names, such as leverdemo from jobs.lever.co/leverdemo. A jobs.eu.lever.co URL is sent to the EU API.

leverEu.title: Lever EU sites
leverEu.description: Lever site names hosted on the EU instance (jobs.eu.lever.co). Read from api.eu.lever.co.

ashby.title: Ashby job boards
ashby.description: Ashby job board names, such as Ashby from jobs.ashbyhq.com/Ashby. Compensation is requested.

workable.title: Workable accounts
workable.description: Workable account slugs, such as huggingface from apply.workable.com/huggingface.

location.title: Location contains
location.description: Optional. Keep jobs where any listed location contains this text (case-insensitive). Separate alternatives with commas, for example: New York, Remote. Remote also matches jobs the ATS flags as remote.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: Any keeps every job. Remote only keeps fully remote jobs. Exclude remote drops them. Hybrid counts as not remote.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional. Keep jobs whose title or department contains any of these as a whole word (case-insensitive). engineer does not match Engineering; list both if you want both.

newSinceLastRun.title: Only new since last run
newSinceLastRun.description: Skip jobs already pushed by an earlier run. Seen job keys and their firstSeen time are kept in the named key-value store below, so they survive between runs.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store that holds seen jobs. Use a different name per saved task to keep separate feeds.

maxItems.title: Max jobs
maxItems.description: Hard cap on job rows pushed this run, after filters and dedupe. Status rows do not count and are not billed.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before each request after the first. Requests run one at a time. The pause jitters upward by up to 1 second.

maxSpendUsd.title: Max spend (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: Job rows are pushed only while their charge fits under this amount. When the next job would pass it, the job feed stops and one free spend_capped row records how many jobs were held back. Default 5, minimum 0.01, maximum 100.
